name: Easy
description: Realistic, but forgiving. Fewer infected, slower looting by others, more on the shelves and in your stores, and people cope better. A place to learn how the systems connect.

name: Normal
description: Realistically difficult. The tuned baseline: a sensible plan usually gets most of the group to day 30, a careless one does not.

name: Hard
description: The same world, harsher. A bigger outbreak, more attacks, emptier shelves, thinner stores, and every loss weighs heavier.
